text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well then. Are your preparations
complete, Agnes Tachyon?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I'm ready whenever you are, President.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon is the jewel of a
distinguished bloodline, with talent
so
great that others overlooked her normally
truant behavior.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And she's up against Symboli Rudolf—the
Emperor who reigns over
Tracen Academy
with her overwhelming prowess.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And here I am, an unexpected witness to
this fight between
titans—the intensity of
this race is giving me goosebumps!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Pant... You're the Emperor, all right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two are neck and neck, but Symboli
Rudolf looks like she has the
upper hand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And now they're entering the final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
(The existence of virtual particles that
travel faster than light without

contradicting special relativity has yet to
be disproven.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
(The top speed of an Umamusume is
theorized to be about seventy
kilometers
per hour, but there's no data that rejects
the possibility of
overcoming that!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
(Understand? It's about potential! My
body—and my legs—are
overflowing with
potential!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon's expression changes
abruptly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hgh?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Faster! Faster! Faster!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The latent potential within an
Umamusume's legs! The limits of this

body's speed!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I've yet to see even a glimpse of either, for
I know that they lie
beyond the horizon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes glitter like those of an innocent
girl... or maybe a deranged
scientist
drowning in her own desire—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her passion takes my breath away.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant, pant!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm exhausted! Absolutely incredible,
Agnes Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, how nice of you. You are the
victor, though.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Only by a nose—Nay, we finished at
essentially the same time. You
are a
formidable foe.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This is why letting you go would be too
great of a loss. Have you had
a change of
heart? Perhaps even a little?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Was this run your attempt to make me feel
longing for this academy?
If so, I regret to
inform you—I've made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see... Then, what about after hearing his
story?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see... Then, what about after hearing her
story?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hm? Whose story?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hm? Whose story?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? What's that look on your face for?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
How should I put this—you look rather
impassioned. Perhaps even
driven to
madness?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't stop thinking about how Agnes
Tachyon ran in that race just
now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And yet she said that her limits lie
"beyond the horizon." Which

means—Agnes Tachyon can still run much,
much faster.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Faster! Faster! Faster!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hey now, don't play dumb with me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You want to scout me, don't you? Well,
cut it out—I don't need any
more delays to
my research.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's right, Agnes Tachyon isn't looking for a normal trainer. For her, even daily training is just another facet of her research. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eureka, I've got it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I do, but what's it to you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I grab the suspiciously-colored medicines
right out of Agnes
Tachyon's outstretched
hand...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, what?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And finish all three in one gulp!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...I'm shocked.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Dare I say, even impressed. Ha... Ha!
AHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen such a willing test subject!
Were you a guinea pig in
your past life?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You certainly say some delightful things.
So you're okay with being
my test subject?
You're okay with me stripping you of your
human
rights? Heh-heh-heh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...What caused this change of heart?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And there it is. Truly driven to madness,
huh? Heh-heh-heh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Very well. Follow me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Slow on the uptake, aren't you? To the
staff room, of course. I can't
drop out if I
have a trainer counting on me, now can I?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, you'll be my guinea
pig—perhaps even worse than that. But
if
you're okay with that, then come with me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you what lies beyond our
limits—what nobody has yet to
witness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, my days of being experimented
upon by Agnes Tachyon
begin!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Hm, actually, let's wait a second. At least
until the side effects wear
off. It'd be a
bother if you caused unnecessary
confusion or chaos.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haven't you noticed? You're glowing.
Greenish gold, if I might add.
